title: Tick Visualizer
description: Displays key performance metrics on your screen, allowing you to instantly understand what is causing game lag.
body:
Tick Visualizer displays key performance metrics on your screen, allowing you to instantly understand what is causing game lag.

![Metrica](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a6b118e35b4fef28443c9bc10a59c8eb65e33f1.png)

**Displayed Metrics:**

- Ping: Your current network latency to the server (in milliseconds).
- TPS (Ticks Per Second): The game's internal clock speed (20.0 is perfect stability).
- MSPT (Milliseconds Per Tick): The exact time it takes to process a single game tick.
- FPS (Frames Per Second): Your current graphic rendering speed.
- Memory: Used versus maximum allocated RAM (in megabytes).
- Chunks: The number of currently loaded world chunks.
- Entities: The total number of active entities (mobs, items, etc.) in your area.
